gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu reads as a contemporary, approachable sans-serif, its curves gaping and its small letters built large. And Mystery Quest brings a nostalgic, bookish display voice that makes the contrast feel deliberate.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Mystery Quest sets a bookish, nostalgic mood with compact ascenders and curves that gape open. Noto Sans Lisu counters with a plain sans, wide-open s curves and tiny gaps between ascender tops and the x-height line.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Mystery Quest has compact ascenders and curved strokes with wide gaping jaws, giving it a nostalgic, bookish feel. But Noto Sans Lydian is the sans-serif that really defines the pair, with capitals barely above lowercase and openings like a sprung paper clip.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Nostalgic and bookish, Mystery Quest curls its strokes into wide gaping curves. Yet Noto Sans Mahajani is the sans-serif that anchors the pair, its lowercase standing proud against the capitals and every e flaring like a funnel.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Nostalgic from the first glance, Mystery Quest has compact ascenders and curves that gape wide. And Noto Sans Marchen is its clean sans partner, with small letters standing almost capital-sized and curves ending in clear daylight.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-mayan-num: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals reads as a professional sans-serif with large-bodied small letters. Its c gapes visibly at any size, so extended text stays open and easy to follow beside Mystery Quest, which brings a bookish, nostalgic touch to the top.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-mende-kik: Noto Sans Mende Kikakui reads as a modern, clean sans-serif, with daylight showing through every curve and lowercase that stands proud of the capitals. Mystery Quest sits above it, bookish and nostalgic, with a gently old-fashioned flavor.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-modi: Mystery Quest has curved strokes that gape wide and compact ascenders, a nostalgic, bookish look. But Noto Sans Modi is a plain sans that holds the pair together, its capitals and lowercase close in height and daylight inside every curve.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-mono: Contemporary and professional, Noto Sans Mono spaces its letters generously so none bump together, and its sturdy lowercase makes words look large. Mystery Quest sets bookish, nostalgic type above, and the plain sans below keeps a long passage open and unhurried.
